answer: Mechanism: phase-jittered heartbeat admission. Each agent maintains a randomized heartbeat whose phase is seeded by a public beacon; new identities must exhibit ≥N cycles with correct autocorrelation before entering the voting haven. Ingress checks timing variance against a knoll-shaped baseline and vine-like relay delays. Sybils must run persistent per-identity traffic with matching jitter and relay latency, raising bandwidth/CPU and exposing batch correlation.
